gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-noto-sans-mandaic: Noto Sans Mandaic curves loosely, its lowercase climbing close to the capitals. Metamorphous is best at commanding attention, with wide sidebearings and a high midline, while the body font is best at quietly carrying text.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-noto-sans-mayan-n: Tall-bodied small letters and a gaping c make this plain sans read big and open. Noto Sans Mayan Numerals tolerates a smaller size well, leaving Metamorphous to be the commanding voice.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-noto-sans-medefai: Crisp and tall, Noto Sans Medefaidrin lets its curves turn without any ink pooling. Metamorphous leads with a high midline and gently swelling strokes, and the tall lowercase below keeps pace without competing.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-noto-sans-meetei-: Cracked-bangle rounds and big lowercase eyes give Noto Sans Meetei Mayek a modern, open face. And Metamorphous, with its light swell in each bowl like pressed glass, supplies the commanding top note.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-noto-sans-mende-k: Metamorphous carries a commanding, gently modulated stroke up top, while Noto Sans Mende Kikakui keeps daylight showing through every curve. What stands out is how clearly each one holds its own job.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-noto-sans-nabatae: Noto Sans Nabataean stands its lowercase almost cap-tall and opens its s curves wide, a plain sans with real presence. Page after page it reads steadily, with Metamorphous adding gravity up top.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-noto-sans-old-nor: Metamorphous sets a commanding tone with its high midline and soft stroke swell. Noto Sans Old North Arabian packs a dense, tall lowercase band with outward-pointing terminals, so paragraphs read compact and approachable rather than sprawling.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-noto-sans-old-sog: Noto Sans Old Sogdian stands tall, its x-height nearly touching cap height. Noto Sans Old Sogdian is best at staying crisp when shrunk, while Metamorphous is best at commanding headings with quiet contrast.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-noto-sans-psalter: Gaping e mouths and barely rising capitals make Noto Sans Psalter Pahlavi feel open, while Metamorphous lends moderate contrast and command. Over a full page the sans stays friendly and easygoing.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-noto-sans-saurash: Noto Sans Saurashtra reads clean, its capitals barely taller than their neighbors. Metamorphous adds fuller stems and slimmer links on top, and the connected counters beneath keep everything flowing without a hard stop.
